items.title: JPMREIT’s First Office Buy Lags Its Industrial Portfolio
items.summary: JPMREIT's office bet was just 62% occupied at midyear, trailing industrial at 99%, as the nontraded REIT grew to $1.75B in gross assets.

items.title: JPMorgan Rises as Wall Street Bets on Record Trading Strength
items.summary: The largest U.S. bank is recovering as investors focus on surging markets revenue instead of bond-market turbulence.

items.title: WMT Stock Extends Declines After Seeing Worst Day In Four Years — But BofA, JPMorgan Insist On Buying
items.summary: Major Wall Street brokerages are advising investors to capitalize on Walmart’s steepest stock drop in four years, maintaining that the retail giant’s long-term growth story remains intact.

items.title: AI Cloud Firm Nscale Is Said to Seek Up to $3 Billion in US IPO
items.summary: Nscale is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion in its US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a rush of artificial intelligence data center companies tapping public market investors.

items.title: Forget RTO: Fully remote workers report the highest well-being—and are less likely to quit, new study of 7,700 employees finds
items.summary: The research found little evidence that remote workers felt less connected to colleagues or workplace culture—despite what CEOs like Jamie Dimon say.

items.title: How SK Hynix Could Top Samsung’s $80 Billion Shareholder Return
items.summary: SK Hynix stock has struggled in recent weeks but it could announce a huge return of cash to shareholders, according to analysts.

items.summary: T. Rowe Price's F/m Investments deal could accelerate fixed-income growth by expanding its ETF and SMA offerings.
